title: regionally-staggered-evacuation-and-slo-mollifier
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Introduce a regional evacuation staggering controller and SLO mollifier to reduce simultaneous tenant impact during node drains and regional failovers. Improves tenant fairness and reduces SLO spikes during mass rebalances. Backwards-compatible runtime flags and telemetry added.
description: Motivation: During incident INC-2025-09 we observed correlated SLO spikes when large numbers of connections were redirected during region-level evacuations. Those spikes were driven by synchronous drain/evac actions and aggressive circuit resets that caused tenant hotspots and perimeter throttling. This PR implements two complementary mechanisms: 1) a regionally-staggered evacuation orchestrator that spreads node drain signals over a configurable window using tenant-cohort bucketing and randomized jitter; 2) an SLO mollifier in the control-plane admission layer that temporarily relaxes strict cutoffs for warmed KV-caching tenants and applies a TTL-based warmup for freshly routed requests to avoid immediate circuit tripping. Summary of changes: added a new evacuation controller (serving/evac/stagger_controller.go) that annotates drain markers, a tenant-cohort allocator (serving/evac/cohort_allocator.go), and an admission SLO mollifier (serving/slo/mollifier.go) which exposes two runtime flags: slo_mollifier_enabled and slo_mollifier_window_ms. Telemetry: new metrics evac.stagger.window_ms, evac.cohort.size, slo.mollifier.active, and slo.mollifier.skipped_trips were introduced and wired into the console dashboards. Rollout plan: feature is behind a runtime flag defaulted to off; smoke canary run targeted a single low-traffic region, followed by progressive rollout to us-west-2 and eu-west-1 with automatic rollback on SLO regression. Backwards compatibility: no API changes; controller identities are stored as annotations so older control-plane components ignore them safely. Testing: unit tests for cohort allocator and mollifier logic, integration test harness that simulates regional drain with synthetic tenants and verifies 95th latency and error-rate behavior, and load test against perf-canary created during the run. Incident tie: this addresses root causes identified in SUP-1284 and ENG-4625, providing a pragmatic mitigation path while longer-term autoscaler improvements are pursued. Known limitations: the current cohort hashing is modulo-based and may produce uneven cohorts under extreme tenant churn; follow-up ENG tickets are linked. Merge notes: resolved a transient CI flake by stubbing a platform clock in tests and updated telemetry naming to avoid collisions with existing evac metrics. This PR is intended as an operational mitigation and should be monitored for any increased tail-latency in edge zones.

review_comments: Diego Ramos: Please add a short e2e scenario that verifies that KV-cached tenants are prioritized during the warmup window. I saw one case in the integration run where a cached tenant was prematurely evicted.
Asha Patel (author): Added integration scenario and adjusted cohort hashing to include tenant stability score. See serving/evac/cohort_allocator.go commit b7e4f10.
Lina Zhang: Telemetry looks good but please avoid introducing a metric name that collides with existing evac.* prefixes. Suggest evac.stagger.window_ms; thanks.
Asha Patel: Renamed metric to evac.stagger.window_ms and updated dashboards. Fixed in f0a2b33.
Michael O'Neill: CI flake on mollifier_test was due to real-time clock dependency; approve after clock stub fix.
Michael O'Neill: Approved with comments. Recommend a 24h staged canary before full region rollout.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash and merge. Squashed with message 'regionally-staggered-evacuation-and-slo-mollifier: operational mitigation for correlated SLO spikes' and merged to main. Deployed to canary cohort on 2025-11-12, monitored for 36h then progressed to staged rollout. No post-merge incidents reported during monitoring window.
post_merge_actions: Deployed canary to us-west-2 with flag slo_mollifier_enabled=true and slo_mollifier_window_ms=300000
Added evac.stagger.* and slo.mollifier.* panels to oncall dashboard
Created ENG follow-up ENG-4699 to replace modulo cohort hashing with rendezvous hashing
notes_for_backport: Cherry-pick to release/2025-11 required for customers on Dedicated who experienced INC-2025-09. Backport must include the clock-stub test fix to avoid CI failures.
ci_logs_summary: Initial CI run failed on mollifier_test due to time dependency. After clock-stub fix CI passed all checks including unit, integration, lint, and canary smoke. Flaky test count dropped to zero for this tree.
